$note.growthMult: How much a Poise threshold grows each time the meter fills, so the second stagger of a fight is dearer than the first. Only while combat ratings are off; with ratings on, Break threshold multiplier sets this.
$note.playerImpactPerHit: Poise the player loses per enemy hit that lands, outside a ruleset that states its own weapon impact. Only while combat ratings are off; with ratings on, the impact rows set how much each hit fills the meter.
$note.onFill.{i}.stacks: Stacks of {statusName} that {recipient} when its Poise meter fills. The player's own fill runs no row from this list — it reads Stagger · Player instead. With combat ratings on, every enemy break runs it too, Poise or Ward, beside the skipped turn.
